docs.title: Master Services Agreement
docs.parties: Prayaan Software Pvt Ltd and Trivenika Systems Pvt Ltd

clauses.title: Term
clauses.text: 2 Apr 2024 to 1 Apr 2027.

clauses.title: Renewal
clauses.text: Renews automatically for 12 months unless either party gives 60 days' written notice.

clauses.title: Order of precedence
clauses.text: Work is described in signed SOWs. If an SOW and the MSA conflict, the SOW prevails on scope and dates; the MSA prevails on everything else.

clauses.title: Delivery dates
clauses.text: Deliverables are due on the dates in their SOW.

clauses.title: Notice of delay
clauses.text: The supplier gives written notice of any expected delay at least 10 Business Days before the due date.

clauses.title: New dates
clauses.text: A new date applies only once agreed in a signed change request.

clauses.title: Fees
clauses.text: Fees are as stated in each SOW.

clauses.title: Rates
clauses.text: Rates are in Schedule A.

clauses.title: Rate increases
clauses.text: Schedule A rates are fixed until 1 Apr 2026. After that, the supplier may increase them once a year, by no more than 8%, with 60 days' written notice.
clauses.value: Up to 8% a year, 60 days' notice

clauses.title: Payment
clauses.text: Payment within 30 days of a valid invoice quoting the SOW and PO numbers.

clauses.title: Key personnel
clauses.text: Named key personnel in an SOW may be replaced only with Prayaan's prior written consent.

clauses.title: Data processing
clauses.text: A data processing agreement must be signed before the supplier processes Prayaan customer personal data.

clauses.title: Delay credits
clauses.text: For each full week a Deliverable is late, the supplier credits 2% of that SOW's fees, up to 10%.

clauses.title: Liability
clauses.text: Liability is capped at the fees paid in the previous 12 months.

clauses.title: Insurance
clauses.text: Professional indemnity insurance of at least ₹2 crore.

clauses.title: Changes
clauses.text: Any change to an SOW's scope, fees or dates needs a change request signed by both parties.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate for convenience with 30 days' notice.

clauses.title: Governing law
clauses.text: India. Courts at Pune.
